cases.answer: Moved 400 GB of customer tables from Oracle to Postgres over a weekend cutover. I wrote the transformation scripts and checked row counts afterward.

replies.text: Same work, yes. I mapped data types with ora2pg, ran two rehearsals on a copy, converted the stored procedures, compared checksums on the big tables, and had a rollback ready Sunday night.
A contractor we hired did the actual move; I gave him the logins.
Yes, data migration is what that was, the same work as data migration.
